# Series fixtures

- `imu.mcap` (2 KB): a spec-valid MCAP file, generated by `make_imu_mcap.py`, which documents its
  layout. `/imu` messages carry three clocks (log time, publish time, `header.stamp`), one was
  recorded out of log-time order and two share a log time; `/battery` has no schema and one message
  without a `percentage`. The official `mcap` reader parses it with CRC checks on.
  `tests/integration/test_series_provenance.py` plays an adapter over it and resolves every series
  row's provenance back to its message.
